data.narrative:
Creotech Instruments is a public-stage space and aerospace company founded by Grzegorz Brona that has raised €52M+ in contracts. The valuation universe for this sector includes 13 identifiable comparables: 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Planet Labs, Astroscale, SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Impulse Space.

Peer-median triangulation is not applicable due to insufficient narrow peer density. While 11 same-sector peers exist, filtering for identical stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier yields fewer than 3 datapoints, making a narrow peer median unreliable. Public-comp anchoring cannot be performed because Creotech's revenue is not on file, preventing application of the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 23.9x across the 6-ticker public set. These methodological constraints—lack of tight-stage peers and missing revenue disclosure—prevent traditional quantitative triangulation.

Without applicable valuation methods, a supported range cannot be calculated. The analysis requires either (i) disclosure of Creotech's revenue or near-term revenue guidance to anchor a P/S multiple, or (ii) identification of additional private comparables at identical stage with known valuations and similar contract/revenue scale. Key uncertainties include the composition and growth trajectory of the €52M+ contract base and revenue recognition timing. A complete valuation requires supplementary financial or transaction data.
